basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old aspiring animator living in Toronto, Canada. I've recently finished my degree in digital media and am passionate about art and storytelling. In my free time, I enjoy sketching, watching animated films, and exploring the world of indie games. I work part-time at an art supply store while building my portfolio. Single and enjoying the creative freedom, I'm mostly online in the evenings after work, typically around 7 PM to midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in digital media, with a focus on animation. I've been self-teaching through online courses and tutorials to improve my skills in using animation software like Blender and Toon Boom. Recently, I've taken an interest in how music rights are handled in animations after noticing their use in popular fan animations.
